name: 92058 · Oceanside, CA
findings: ZIP 92058 (Oceanside) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92058 (Oceanside) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92058 (Oceanside) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
